title: Hyperspectral Imaging
definition: Hyperspectral imaging records a spectrum at each spatial sample, producing a data cube with two spatial dimensions and one spectral dimension. Unlike a multispectral instrument with a small set of broad bands, a hyperspectral instrument usually samples many narrow, contiguous bands. There is no universal band-count threshold, so a useful specification gives wavelength range, spectral sampling and spectral response rather than relying on the label alone.
